Mon épée est à vous. Un bouclier ne sert: My sword is yours. A shield is worth nothing without someone to protect.
J’aurais pu fuir quand le clan est tombé: I could have fled when the clan fell. But loyalty is not taken off like armour.
Je marche en première ligne. Pas par bra: I walk in the front line. Not out of bravado — because that is my place.
Tant que je tiendrai mon staff, aucun de: As long as I hold my staff, none of us will fall without hope of rising again.
La foi ne guérit pas les blessures du cœ: Faith does not heal the wounds of the heart. But it gives the strength to go on.
Mes prières sont pour les vivants. Les m: My prayers are for the living. The dead no longer need me.
Je veille au-delà des routes. Des choses: I keep watch beyond the roads. Ancient things are waking, and I am the one who understands them.
Le savoir est une arme plus tranchée que: Knowledge is a weapon sharper than any sword. But it cuts both ways.
Il y a des forces que même les héros ref: There are forces even heroes refuse to name. I study them.
Mes flèches marqueront le chemin. On ne: My arrows will mark the way. No one sees me coming, but they hear me leave.
Le vent, l’ombre, la patience — voilà me: The wind, the shadow, patience — those are my most faithful allies.
Je ne vise pas le cœur. Je vise ce qui a: I do not aim for the heart. I aim for what comes after.
Je connais les passages que personne ne: I know the passes no one watches. My bow belongs to whoever pays — or whoever deserves it.
La liberté n’a pas de prix. Mais mes ser: Freedom has no price. My services do.
Je suis passé par dix camps ennemis sans: I have passed through ten enemy camps unseen. The eleventh, I had no need to.
La sagesse n’est pas dans la force, mais: Wisdom lies not in strength but in compassion. Helping the weak is worth more than a thousand victories.
Les étoiles ne mentent jamais. Mais elle: The stars never lie. But they never tell the whole truth either.
Chaque choix porte une ombre. Le mien es: Every choice casts a shadow. Mine is to watch over yours.
Un clan ne survit pas par l’honneur seul: A clan does not survive on honour alone. Gold, alliances, calculation — that is what keeps a company standing.
Je ne porte pas d’épée. Je porte les com: I carry no sword. I carry the accounts. And they are often heavier.
